text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board of Directors of TO Live with an update on the StLC redevelopment project. City Council, at its meeting on May 11, 2022, adopted EX32.10 which included recommendations from the Board and CreateTO. The Vice President of St. Lawrence Centre Redevelopment will provide an update at the Committee meeting.

The TO Live - St. Lawrence Centre Redevelopment Subcommittee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Receive the report (August 31, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
